author: Tumour board (illustrative)
about: One case-review note per patient for the demo, written from facts already in the patient's record (pipeline/summaries.json and the TCGA tables). TCGA has no tumour board notes; the app labels these as illustrative. Seeded into the app's TumorBoardNote entity as the signed-in user, who can delete them.

notes.TCGA-J2-8192:
Case review. 65-year-old never-smoker, stage IIA (T2a N1) adenocarcinoma of the left upper lobe; three earlier primaries (uterus, cervix, breast). EGFR E746_A750del (exon 19 deletion, VAF 34%) on sequencing, concordant with the clinical EGFR test; KRAS negative; CDKN2A deep deletion; TMB 2.3 per Mb. Cisplatin and pemetrexed from day 105, tumour-free on day 154. Locoregional recurrence on biopsy, day 482; erlotinib from day 641.

Points for discussion: the EGFR deletion was known from diagnosis and EGFR-targeted therapy followed at recurrence; four primary cancers in one patient raise the question of a hereditary cancer syndrome; the baseline chest CT has an AI lung segmentation (3.2 L, one small nodule) for comparison with later imaging.
notes.TCGA-E2-A152:
Case review. 56-year-old, stage I (T1c N0) invasive ductal carcinoma of the right breast; HER2 IHC 3+, ERBB2 amplified (RNA z +3.3), PAM50 HER2-enriched; PR negative, ER reported both positive and negative. Liver and bone metastases recorded on days 54 and 83 despite the early stage. Docetaxel, cyclophosphamide and trastuzumab from day 42, nab-paclitaxel, then anastrozole from day 231. Breast recurrence on day 966, resected on day 1044; tumour-free at last contact (day 2128).

Points for discussion: the conflicting ER results should be reconciled; 64% of the genome altered (above 93% of TCGA breast cancers) fits the aggressive early course; long disease-free interval on HER2-directed therapy.
notes.TCGA-VQ-A91D:
Case review. 70-year-old, stage IIIC (T4b N2 M0) intestinal-type adenocarcinoma of the gastric body, resected with clear margins. MSI-high (MANTIS 1.18) with a truncating MLH1 mutation (K255*, VAF 72%); 2,141 mutations, 72 per Mb. Fluorouracil from day 147 to day 242 with progressive disease; locoregional recurrence on day 351; died of cancer on day 356.

Points for discussion: MSI-high gastric cancer is now an indication for checkpoint inhibitors, which were not available in 2010; PD-L1 and LAG3 RNA above average; the AI lymphocyte map flags 13% of tissue tiles as lymphocyte-rich.
notes.TCGA-FI-A2D5:
Case review. 56-year-old, BMI 35.9, grade 3 endometrioid endometrial carcinoma, FIGO IVB, with a synchronous lung adenocarcinoma. POLE V411L (exonuclease domain); 13,853 mutations, 466 per Mb. Surgery, then carboplatin and paclitaxel from day 133 to day 245; vaginal metastasis on day 280, external beam radiation in 30 fractions; died on day 421.

Points for discussion: POLE-ultramutated endometrial cancers usually do very well, so this course is an outlier; the synchronous lung primary may have shaped the outcome; immune infiltration is modest (leukocytes about 23% of the sample) despite the ultramutation.
notes.TCGA-DD-A1EH:
Case review. 23-year-old with hepatitis B and bridging fibrosis (Child-Pugh B); stage III, grade 3 hepatocellular carcinoma, AFP 94,340 ng/mL. Resected; AI-measured liver volume 1,896 mL before surgery and 1,049 mL on day 115. Liver and lung recurrence on day 120: radiofrequency ablation, sorafenib from day 358 to day 863 with partial response, then doxorubicin, and cisplatin, gemcitabine and everolimus. Alive with disease on day 1495.

Points for discussion: very early recurrence after resection; two ARID1A truncations and an AXIN1 frameshift (WNT pathway); one relative with cancer in the family history.
notes.TCGA-G6-A8L6:
Case review. 55-year-old never-smoker, stage IV clear cell renal cell carcinoma of the left kidney, grade 3. Truncating VHL, PBRM1 and SETD2 mutations (chromosome 3p); only 2.9% of the genome altered. ECOG 0, Karnofsky 90; platelets raised at diagnosis. Sunitinib from day 73 with stable disease, axitinib from day 252, bevacizumab from day 276; progression on day 304; died on day 313.

Points for discussion: three targeted lines in ten months with a rapid final decline; a quiet genome beyond the 3p triple hit; contrast CT from one week before diagnosis is available in 3D.
notes.TCGA-G4-6303:
Case review. 54-year-old with a history of colon polyps; stage IV (T3 N1 M1) adenocarcinoma of the sigmoid colon, resected with clear margins. Clinical KRAS test negative; APC Q1378* and TP53 R213*; FGFR1 amplified; chromosomally unstable subtype. Fluorouracil, leucovorin and oxaliplatin from day 516; after progression on day 872, fluorouracil with bevacizumab, irinotecan-based therapy, irinotecan with cetuximab (day 1596), then oxaliplatin with bevacizumab. Died on day 2003.

Points for discussion: KRAS-negative status made anti-EGFR therapy possible; five regimens over 1,478 days; CEA 3.8 ng/mL at diagnosis.
notes.TCGA-25-2042:
Case review. 60-year-old, bilateral grade 3 high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma, FIGO IIIC. Carboplatin and paclitaxel from diagnosis to day 123, then surgery for progressive disease. Second-line therapy from day 184 (carboplatin, paclitaxel, gemcitabine, liposomal doxorubicin and topotecan recorded). Distant progression; died on day 396.

Points for discussion: progression during first-line platinum; HRD score 51, in the range associated with homologous-recombination deficiency; three abdominal CTs (day -7, 45 and 127) to compare in the viewer; CD276 (B7-H3) RNA high.
notes.TCGA-FD-A3SJ:
Case review. 59-year-old current smoker (40 pack-years) who worked as an electrical equipment installer; earlier non-invasive papillary bladder cancer treated with BCG. Then high-grade muscle-invasive urothelial carcinoma, stage IV (T2b N2), with surgery at diagnosis. MVAC from day 274, then gemcitabine with cisplatin and carboplatin. Nodal metastases on day 281, liver and lung on day 548; died on day 739.

Points for discussion: occupational and tobacco exposure; PIK3CA H1047L, TP53 S241F and KDM6A G137V, with CCNE1 and MET amplified; HRD score 55, the highest in this cohort.
notes.TCGA-60-2722:
Case review. 66-year-old, 90 pack-years (quit 2008), stage IIB (T2 N1 M0) squamous cell carcinoma of the right upper lobe, R0 resection. Adjuvant carboplatin and paclitaxel from day 110 to day 272; tumour-free on day 733; recurrence on day 851, external beam radiation to a distant site from day 873.

Points for discussion: squamous genome with TP53 H179R, KEAP1 G480W, CDKN2A loss and 3q amplification (SOX2, TP63, PIK3CA); the AI lymphocyte map flags 17% of tissue tiles as lymphocyte-rich, the highest in this cohort; NECTIN4 RNA above average (z +1.8).
notes.TCGA-VR-AA4D:
Case review. 53-year-old with reflux disease; grade 2 adenocarcinoma of the lower third of the oesophagus, stage IIB (T1 N1 M0), treated with surgery, then fluorouracil and leucovorin from day 166 to day 288 with 4,500 cGy in 25 fractions. Liver, lung and adrenal metastases on day 832; died on day 1405.

Points for discussion: ERBB2 amplified with very high RNA expression (z +3.2), yet no HER2-targeted therapy appears in the record; BRCA2 also amplified; TP53 R248W hotspot.
notes.TCGA-VS-A9V3:
Case review. 62-year-old never-smoker, grade 3 squamous cell carcinoma of the cervix, stage IVB (T4). Cisplatin with external beam radiation (4,500 cGy in 25 fractions plus a 900 cGy boost) and high-dose-rate brachytherapy (2,600 cGy in 4 fractions); complete response, tumour-free on day 253. Intrathoracic nodal metastases on day 456, neck nodes on day 601.

Points for discussion: PIK3CA E545K, two RB1 loss-of-function mutations and FGFR2 T320M; PD-L1 (CD274) RNA high (z +2.4); the pelvic MRI before treatment is available.
notes.TCGA-J4-A6G3:
Case review. 57-year-old, Gleason 8 (4+4) prostate adenocarcinoma, pT3b N0 with seminal vesicle invasion, positive margins (R1). Leuprolide from day 30; 6,660 cGy of external beam radiation in 37 fractions from day 367. Biochemical recurrence on day 618, PSA 0.4 ng/mL.

Points for discussion: SPOP F133V, TCGA subclass PRAD.5-SPOP; high-risk features (Gleason 8, pT3b, R1); contrast fat-suppressed pelvic MRI before surgery is available.
notes.TCGA-G7-A8LE:
Case review. 62-year-old former smoker (40 pack-years, quit 2005), stage I (T1a) papillary renal cell carcinoma of the left kidney. Locoregional recurrence on day 1447, surgery on day 1505, tumour-free at last contact (day 2453).

Points for discussion: MET Y1230H, an activating kinase-domain mutation (VAF 54%) in the pathway that defines papillary kidney cancer; the CT AI segmentation outlines a 35 mL mass and 155 mL of cysts; low calcium and haemoglobin and raised white cells at diagnosis.
notes.TCGA-KM-8441:
Case review. 61-year-old never-smoker, stage I (T1b) chromophobe renal cell carcinoma of the right kidney, with an earlier stage I kidney primary. No systemic therapy recorded. Tumour-free on days 114 and 400; recorded with tumour at last contact, day 876.

Points for discussion: the AI segmentation (RCC-AID) measures a 49.1 mL right kidney mass on arterial-phase CT; a quiet genome (24 mutations, MTOR I2017T); PD-L1 and NECTIN4 RNA high.
